subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: What graduation path should OpenClaw use for `experimental.sessionMemory` now that transcript indexing exists but privacy, source-policy, QMD, duplicate-hit, ranking, and cost questions remain open?
rationale: Changing this from experimental opt-in to stable/default-on affects transcript privacy, session-state semantics, indexing cost, and config/default behavior, which requires maintainer intent rather than an autonomous code fix.

options.title: Keep opt-in until criteria pass
options.body: Keep `sessionMemory` experimental while fixing the linked concrete bugs and documenting source labels, visibility, QMD export, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, and cost expectations.

options.title: Stabilize but keep opt-in
options.body: Remove the experimental framing only after the caller/source contract and docs are complete, but do not enable transcript indexing by default.

options.title: Default on for new installs
options.body: Enable session transcript indexing for new installs after maintainers explicitly accept the privacy/cost tradeoff and require live fresh-install and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Keep opt-in until criteria pass
recommendation.body: Keep `sessionMemory` experimental while fixing the linked concrete bugs and documenting source labels, visibility, QMD export, duplicate-indexing, ranking, privacy, and cost expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is mainly product/default and documentation policy, and steipete has recent history on source-grounded docs and broad session/runtime surfaces.
